europe_now.title: Wildfire Crisis in Europe
europe_now.summary: Wildfires have forced evacuations in Greece, causing anger among residents. In France's touristy southwest, authorities are assessing the economic impact of the fires.

sources.headline: In blazing Greece, anger grows among residents forced to evacuate
After the fires, France's touristy southwest reckons with their economic fallout

europe_now.title: Ceuta Migration Situation
europe_now.summary: Migrants have arrived in Ceuta, prompting families to gather at the border seeking news. Spain has said it expects EU solidarity as officials convene emergency talks and exchange blame over the surge and its causes.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen rallies to support Spain after Ceuta crisis
Ceuta: Parents gather at Moroccan border, desperate for news of their children

top_stories.title: Moscow Restaurant Bombing
top_stories.summary: A bomb exploded at a Moscow restaurant, killing three people. Russian authorities have described the blast as a terror attack and opened an investigation.

sources.headline: Steve Rosenberg at the Moscow restaurant where bomb killed three

top_stories.title: France Tightens Foreign Investment Screening
top_stories.summary: France has announced tighter screening of foreign investments deemed sensitive to national security. The measure aims to protect critical sectors from external influence.

sources.headline: France bolsters checks on ‘sensitive’ foreign investments

top_stories.title: Ukrainian Drone Strike on Russian Warehouse
top_stories.summary: A Ukrainian drone strike caused a fire at a Wildberries warehouse in Russia. The retailer reported the incident as part of ongoing cross-border hostilities.

sources.headline: Russia's online retailer Wildberries says warehouse on fire after Ukrainian drone attack
